internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The 40 occurrences do not share one meaning. There is one strong, internally clean verbal sense: 'to perceive/notice/be aware of' something subtle or hidden. Strikingly, all 27 verbal tokens appear only under negation, prohibition, or counterfactual (laA/wamaA ya$oEuruwn; law ta$oEuruwn 26:113; walaA yu$oEiranna 18:19; wamaA yu$oEirukum 6:109) - the Quran names this faculty only at its point of failure and never affirms successful perception. Alongside this verb sit four lexicalized noun/name classes that share only the consonants $-E-r: >a$oEaAr = animal hair (16:80), $aAEir/$uEaraA'/$iEr = poet/poetry (a polemical slur, contrasted with revelation in 36:69), $aEaA}ir/al-ma$oEar = consecrated ritual markers/waymark (2:158, 2:198, 5:2, 22:32, 22:36), and al-$iEraY = the star Sirius (53:49). No verse links any of these to 'perceive'. Because these classes resist the verbal sense and no Quran-internal bridge unites them, the honest result is multi-class: a representative verbal account, not a single root meaning.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: $oEr(verb) != Eilm (knowledge): 27:65 juxtaposes them - none knows (laA yaEolamu) the ghayb but God, 'and they do not perceive (wamaA ya$oEuruwn) when they are resurrected'; $uEuwr is a lower, pre-cognitive register, not settled propositional knowledge. $oEr(verb) != baSar (sight): 28:11 - the sister physically watched (faba$urat bihi) while the Egyptians 'did not perceive' (wahum laA ya$oEuruwn). $oEr(verb) is orthogonal to intent/agency: deliberate schemers still 'perceive not' (makaruw... wahum laA ya$oEuruwn 27:50; also 6:123, 6:26, 3:69, 2:9). The verb never carries positive affirmation in the corpus. The perceive-sense does NOT reach hair (16:80), poet/poetry (36:69 and the $aAEir slur), ritual markers (5:2), or the star Sirius (53:49) - these carry no perceptual content in any verse.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 16:80:21:2 - wa>a$oEaArihaA >avaAvFA wamataAEFA: >a$oEaAr is concrete animal HAIR, coordinated with wool (>aSowaAf) and fur (>awobaAr) as raw material for furnishings. It has zero awareness/perception content and cannot be generated from 'perceive' - nor 'perceive' from it - without an external etymological bridge the source policy forbids. This single occurrence falsifies any claim that one nucleus spans all 40 tokens (53:49 al-$iEraY, the star, is a second such homonym).

Rejected as a RESULT because it is exactly the 'vague abstraction that fits everything' and rests entirely on imported etymology: the packet contains no derivational or contextual verse activating 'fineness' as a shared feature, and never links hair, poets, rites, or the star back to the perceive-verb. internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently converged on MULTI-CLASS / MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE. The verbal family (Form I + Form IV, 27/40) is broad, distinctive (contrasted with Eilm at 27:65 and baSar at 28:11), carries a genuine negative-polarity signature (every one of the 27 tokens is negated or counterfactual), and is adversarially clean with zero resistant members within its class; the Form IV causative (18:19, 6:109) is a Quran-internally demonstrable bridge to Form I (same perceive-content + causer). On its own the verbal claim would rate STRONG. But the unit is the root, and four nominal/onomastic classes (hair x1, poet/poetry x6, rites x5, star-PN x1) are unbridged by any Quran-internal step - two of them (16:80 hair, 53:49 Sirius) are frank homonyms and one (poet/poetry) is counter-valenced against truth/revelation (36:69). Per contract, coherent resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-classes cap root-level strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE; a single STRONG/UNIVERSAL nucleus for the whole root would require forbidden etymological priors and is not supported. This is reported as a representative verbal derivational-family account with the nominal classes explicitly recorded as persistent resistance, not as forced unity.
